title: Phyloseq dataset examples
text: Another nice feature possibility set fill color depending property entries. reproduce differential abundance analysis example using data Kostic et al. (2012) visualize results coloring taxa according association colorectal carcinoma. First, differential abundance testing using DESeq2 package: making sure taxa still order results data frame, plot phyloseq object additionally supply log2 fold change respect diagnosis (color = ...) illustrate strength association (positive negative) colorectal carcinoma. strong association Fusobacterium cancer clearly visible. chart also colors non-significant associations. can set log2 fold change NA , significant nodes shown. Higher ranks still colored association contained taxa significant (see summary_fn ChartAttribute()).
code: library(phyloseq)  filepath <- system.file('extdata', 'study_1457_split_library_seqs_and_mapping.zip',                         package='phyloseq') kostic <- microbio_me_qiime(filepath) kostic <- subset_samples(kostic, DIAGNOSIS != 'None')  # use pre-computed log2-fold change and p-values if possible kostic_da_file <- '_kostic_da.txt' if (!file.exists(kostic_da_file)) {   library(DESeq2)   diagdds <- phyloseq_to_deseq2(kostic, ~ DIAGNOSIS)   diagdds <- DESeq(diagdds, sfType = 'poscounts', test = 'Wald', fitType = 'parametric')   res <- results(diagdds, cooksCutoff = F)   kostic_da <- as.data.frame(res)[,c('log2FoldChange', 'padj')]   write.table(kostic_da, kostic_da_file, sep = '\t', quote = FALSE) } kostic_da <- read.delim(kostic_da_file) library(taxplore)  stopifnot(taxa_names(kostic) == rownames(kostic_da)) plot_krona(kostic,        color = kostic_da$log2FoldChange,        color_label = 'avg. log2 fold change',         # optional, to adjust the color scale        color_value_range = c(-1.8, 1.8)) logfc_sig <- with(kostic_da, ifelse(!is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05, log2FoldChange, NA)) plot_krona(kostic,        color = logfc_sig,        color_label = 'avg. log2 fold change (p.adj < 0.05)',        color_value_range = c(-1.8, 1.8))

title: Feature overview and tutorial
text: example code shows use charts Shiny app (opens separate window). also requires phyloseq installed.
code: library(shiny) library(phyloseq) library(taxplore)  data(grasslandfungi, grasslandfungi.records, GlobalPatterns, enterotype)  # each dataset is a list(taxonomy, magnitude) tax_ranks <- names(grasslandfungi.records) datasets <- list(   `Survey of grassland fungi` = list(grasslandfungi[tax_ranks], grasslandfungi$n_total),   `Global patterns of 16S diversity` = list(tax_table(GlobalPatterns), taxa_sums(GlobalPatterns)),   `Enterotypes of the human gut microbiome` = list(tax_table(enterotype), taxa_sums(enterotype)) )  ui <- bslib::page_fluid(   titlePanel('Visualize community datasets'),   radioButtons(     'dataset',     'Select dataset',     choices = names(datasets),     selected = names(datasets)[1]   ),   checkboxInput('use_abund', 'Use abundances', value = TRUE),   KronaChartOutput('chart', height='40em') )  server <- function(input, output) {   output$chart <- renderKronaChart({     d <- datasets[[input$dataset]]     plot_krona(d[[1]], magnitude = if (input$use_abund) d[[2]])   }) }  shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)

title: Chart attribute specification — ChartAttribute
text: Attributes provide information nodes classification tree, displayed top-right area chart node clicked. generating Krona charts matrix/data frame/phyloseq object, name data required. pre-computed nested tree provided classification, name required indicate name list entry containing data. Also, options apply: dataset_summary_fn, allow_extra_data, missing_fill, only_ranks. Numeric data can used custom coloring (see color make_krona). External links can displayed setting hrefBase href. title: Chart attribute specification — ChartAttribute
text: name name label. case generating charts tree structure (nested lists), name identifies attribute. data attribute data, can vector matrix/data frame (see details) displayName Optional longer label displayed next attribute value instead name text Text displayed node, function used generate text, form text(node_name, attribute_value) missing_value Behavior case missing attribute values: default (missing_value = NA), attribute hidden list attributes top-right corner underlying data NA currently selected node. explicitly always include attribute list, e.g. set missing_value = 'N/'. Note: using attribute coloring, missing_value also set character string, otherwise color value 0 assumed. make_krona(color = ...) automatically. hrefBase Optional base URL prepended value (href path). text turned link hrefBase defined. href URL URL component following common hrefBase prefix, function generating form href(node_name, attribute_value) max_digits number digits use formatting numeric data. default max_digits ChartOpts. summary_fn Summary function aggregating data higher ranks. function look follows: summary_fn(attribute_data, magnitudes) attribute_data vector values. default function numeric data calculates weighted mean: weighted.mean(attribute_data, magnitudes, na.rm=TRUE). case character vector/matrix, default function assigns item lower/inner rank nested items equal, otherwise assigns NA. allow_extra_data Suppress warnings regarding extra entries data found classification. missing_fill Numeric character value use missing entries present classification attribute data. Default: NA (another good choice numeric values missing_fill = 0). mistaken missing_value, just controls attributes displayed. only_ranks Optional vector names indices classification rank columns attribute displayed dataset_summary_fn: Function rowwise summary data columns across datasets (see groups make_krona). function must accept vector vector values return single value. default sum numeric values. Character items group retained equal, otherwise NA returned.

title: General chart options — ChartOpts
text: max_digits Maximum number significant digits print decimal numbers. Reducing <7 digits (default) may help obtaining smaller HTML files. total_label Label total abundance displayed top right chart. method HTML generation method ('internal' 'kronatools'), '  passed generate_krona_html minify TRUE, minified version Krona JavaScript included Automatically activated plot_krona embedded option ignored method = 'kronatools' effect resources_url provided. hue_range: Hue start end points fill gradient coloring user-specified gradient (see color color_value_range arguments make_krona). unknown_label: Label set instead NAs classification/taxonomy (present). default, NAs left place, resulting fewer child nodes. Krona charts handle situation well (see e.g. https://krona.sourceforge.net/examples/xml.krona.html). root_label: Label use root taxonomic tree. displayed uppermost level hierarchy one category, collapse disabled (see ChartDisplayOpts). resources_url: Optional URL pointing remote Javascript image resources, linked instead embedded chart. resulting charts standalone require internet connection displaying, HTML file size smaller. Example: resources_url = 'http://marbl.github.io/Krona/' given URL address serve contents 'src' 'img' directories KronaTools (https://github.com/marbl/Krona/tree/master/KronaTools) (see copy_krona_resources). kronatools_dir: Optional path pointing 'KronaTools' directory extracted Krona source code archive, downloaded . option ignored method = 'internal'. snapshot TRUE, Krona chart immediately turned non-interactive snapshot. contrast interactive parameter plot_krona, option permanently modifies chart HTML code, files exported outfile = ... also non-interactive.
